title: EDGAR acceptance times: the submissions file against each filing's index page
method: For 25 companies, the 12 newest filings in each submissions file (data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json) plus 6 accepted in December, January or February. Each acceptanceDateTime was compared with the Accepted time printed on the filing's index page (US Eastern, the same as the filing's SGML header), converted to UTC with the America/New_York rules.
